note: Signs ranked for review by how much a wrong one would cost. Heuristic, not a measure: see tools/review-packet.ts.

signs.description: Two fists at the chest spring open and draw back.
Both flat hands start before the mouth and are drawn down and apart.
The fingers of one hand slice down the back of the other, as when cutting a loaf.
An index finger touches the palm of the other hand, and both move forward.
signs.notes: Contact between the hands is positional.

signs.description: An index finger twists between the fingers of the other hand.
An index finger flicks forward off the palm of the other hand.
An H hand draws a cross on the upper arm.
signs.notes: Only one stroke of the cross is drawn.

signs.description: A C hand sweeps in an arc across the chest.
A hand swings out from the nose like a trunk.
Index points off to one side, at a person in the signing space.
The fingertips of one bent hand brush upward across the other, twice.
Two bent hands brush upward on the chest, twice.
The hand bounces out and away from the face, the second half of GRANDMOTHER and GRANDFATHER.
A hand pats the thigh, as when calling a dog.
signs.notes: The snap that follows the pat is not rendered.

signs.description: Two index fingers move forward from the lips.
Both flat hands, palms up, move out from the stomach.
signs.notes: Differs from PREGNANT in orientation and in using both hands.

signs.description: An A hand near the cheek, shaken.
A Q hand sweeps from one shoulder down to the opposite hip.
geometry: elbow: right elbow passes through the torso at 420ms (9.6cm out)

signs.description: A bent index finger twists against the cheek.
Both clawed hands scratch down the chest, arms crossed.
signs.notes: Starts with the arms already crossed: mirrored hands cannot cross each other on the way in without passing through.

signs.description: A V hand twists against the cheek.
Open hands close into fists as they are drawn in, as if grasping.
signs.notes: The grasp is a change of handshape along the path.

signs.description: Index points at the signer’s chest and arcs across to the other side.
Both flat hands, palms up, make small circles in front of the body.
Dominant index hand brought down onto the non-dominant index hand.
Flat hand from the chin, lowered forward onto the other palm.
A V hand leaves the eyes and moves forward.
Dominant open hand sweeps around and settles into the other palm.
Two bent hands back to back, rolling up to face the viewer.
Index and middle finger closing onto the thumb.
Both hands open and palms up, shaken slightly.
Dominant index circles the other index and lands on it.
An index finger taps the back of the other wrist.
A C hand at the forehead closes and opens, like taking hold of a cap brim.
signs.notes: The grasp is two alternating handshapes.

signs.description: One fist taps the back of the other wrist.
A bent hand drops over the back of the other flat hand.
Both arms cradle and rock from side to side.
signs.notes: The real sign is the forearms cradled one over the other; the base hand is held in place.

signs.description: Two hands come together and clasp.
signs.notes: The clasp is positional; the hands do not interlock.

signs.description: One fist rests on the other and both twist.
Index finger pointing at the signer’s own chest.
Dominant fist resting on the open non-dominant palm, both lifting.
A flat hand starts above the head and lowers.
Both O hands open and move apart.
An upright index arm sweeps down across the other forearm.
A bent hand turns over and lands in the other palm.
One flat hand wipes along the palm of the other.
signs.notes: One sign for both "clean" and "nice". Contact is positional.

signs.description: An open hand rises, fingers closing into a pinch.
Both L hands move up the body.
signs.notes: The same movement as LIVE with an L handshape.

signs.description: The back of a flattened O taps the other open palm.
The edge of a flat hand chops down onto the other palm.
Two hands held palms up, fingers fluttering.
A W hand circles around a fist.
Two H hands; the dominant taps twice across the non-dominant.
The back of one hand sweeps up off the other palm.
Two index fingers held side by side, pointing forward.
A fist at the chin is drawn down, as if stroking a beard.
A flat hand sways back and forth over the forearm.
A closed hand at the forehead flicks the index up.
A flat hand rises from under the other forearm.
Both fists spring open, again and again.
Two hooked index fingers link, release and link the other way.
Two bent hands meet as rooftops, again and again.
A bent V hand knocks on another, twice.
signs.notes: One sign for both "difficult" and "solid". Contact between the hands is positional.

signs.description: Both R hands move together to one side.
A cupped hand held to the ear.
Both T hands push forward together.
Bent V knuckles twist against each other.
signs.notes: Differs from HARD in twisting rather than tapping.

signs.description: A thumb, held out, swings to the side.
Flat hand pats downward at a child’s height.
Open hand raised, fingers folding and opening in a wave.
One flat hand claps down onto the other palm.
An M hand taps the wrist of the other hand, as when taking a pulse.
signs.notes: Contact with the wrist is positional.

signs.description: An L hand, thumb on the palm, twists forward.
Two R hands, palms facing, outline the walls of a room.
signs.notes: Differs from READY only in palm orientation.

signs.description: A flat hand swings on the edge of the other, like a door on its hinge.
Fingertips brush forward across the other open palm.
The middle finger touches the forehead.
One fist circles all the way round the other and lands on it.
A C hand taps the chest where a badge would be.
An index finger circles the face.
signs.notes: The circle is four points; it is a rough loop, not a smooth one.

signs.description: Two bent hands circle alternately in front of the face.
Two fists held at the chest shiver.
signs.notes: A shiver is rendered as a slow twist.

signs.description: Both F hands rise and meet.
An index finger circles at the temple.
signs.notes: The circle is a back-and-forth.

signs.description: Two bent fingers come down onto two others and rest on them.
signs.notes: Contact is positional. Differs from CHAIR in making one movement, not two taps, and from NAME in handshape.

signs.description: A flat hand wipes across the forehead and closes.
Two fists turn over in opposite directions.
An L hand taps on the palm of the other hand.
Dominant hand lifts from the other palm to the forehead.
An index hand slides forward across the other palm.
A U hand near the temple, shaken.
The fingertips of a flat hand tap the shoulder.
Pinched fingers at the eyes spring open.
Both hands flick their middle fingers off the thumbs, outward.
A C hand at the mouth turns outward and down, as if spitting out something hot.
An L hand flicks closed, the index snapping toward the thumb.
signs.notes: A snap is two handshapes.

signs.description: An H hand brushes the nose, twice.
A flattened O flicks open and away from the other hand.
A flattened O takes money from the palm of the other hand and moves forward.
A V hand stands, fingers down, on the palm of the other hand.
A pinch picks something from the air and lifts it.
A V hand scans down the face of the other palm.
Two fists held together snap apart.
Two fingers snip like scissors, moving forward.
signs.notes: The snip is a change from V to U.

signs.description: Pinched fingers drop open, letting something go.
Both hands, fingers wiggling, rise like flames.
signs.notes: The flicker is not rendered.

signs.description: A flat hand against the cheek, as a head on a pillow.
signs.notes: Angled so the thumb clears the head; the head tilt is not rendered.

signs.description: Two fists knock together, twice.
A V hand standing on the palm of the other tips over.
Flat hand laid against the chest, palm inward.
A K hand sweeps from one shoulder down to the opposite hip.
Thumb and index finger take hold of a strand of hair.
A fist at the shoulder moves outward, as a flexed arm does.
An open hand on the chest is drawn out, closing.
A flat hand circles on the back of the other.
Both flattened O hands swing forward and out, away from the body.
A V hand moves forward in an arc, fingers walking.
signs.notes: The walking fingers are not rendered.

signs.description: A V hand swings back and forth over the other palm.
A pinched hand writes across the palm of the other.
Two V hands circle forward alternately.
An index finger slides down the other index finger, as down a calendar.
A flat hand stands upright on the forearm of the other.
One fist circles on top of the other, grinding.
A U hand, thumb at the temple, with the fingers flapping like ears.
A flat hand swims forward, wriggling.
signs.notes: The wriggle is a sway; one sign for the animal and the food.

signs.description: A hand held up and to the side, opening its fingers like rays.
Two index fingers brush past each other going up, alternately.
A flat hand taps down on the other flat hand, as on a tabletop.
A bent V hand taps twice on another, as a seat.
signs.notes: Differs from SIT only in tapping twice.

signs.description: A C hand taps on the back of a fist.
The heel of one hand brushes across the other, twice.
Two fingers slide along two fingers, as a train on its track.
An N hand taps the wrist of the other hand.
signs.notes: Contact with the wrist is positional.

signs.description: An index finger circles forward from the mouth.
A V hand, fingers pointing at the eyes, pokes toward them.
A middle finger rubs in the other palm.
signs.notes: The rub is a short back-and-forth, not a circle.

signs.description: A flat hand moves outward from the stomach, tracing its curve.
Two index fingers trace the corners of the mouth upward.
Two index fingers at the corners of the mouth bob up and down.
Two index fingers trace tears down the cheeks.
Two middle fingers brush up the chest, alternating.
A thumb slides up the chest.
Both open hands shake in front of the body.
signs.notes: A tremble is rendered as a slow sway.

signs.description: An index finger rests at the side of the nose and twists.
A hand at the mouth squeezes, as when squeezing an orange.
signs.notes: One sign for both the fruit and the colour.

signs.description: Fingers wiggle at the chin.
signs.notes: The finger wiggle is not rendered.

signs.description: One hand slides slowly up the back of the other.
signs.notes: Contact with the other hand is positional.

signs.description: The back of a hand under the chin, fingers wiggling.
signs.notes: The wiggle is not rendered.

signs.description: Both F hands drop from the forehead.
Fingers wiggle toward the palm of the other hand.
signs.notes: The wiggle is not rendered.

signs.description: A flat hand turns over on the palm of the other, as when turning food.
A K hand turns over on the palm of the other.
A T hand makes a small circle and finishes as an H.
signs.notes: The T-to-H change is made partway round the circle.

signs.description: Two W hands held at the chest shiver.
signs.notes: Differs from COLD only in handshape.

signs.description: A hand opens and closes, as when milking.
A pinching hand takes hold of the fleshy part of the other hand and shakes it.
Two flat hands press together and twist.
An F hand twists against the cheek.
A beak opens and closes at the mouth.
Fingers open and close at the mouth like a bill.
The back of a hand under the chin, fingers flapping.
A bent V hand, as fangs, weaves forward.
Both bent hands pat the chest alternately.
A C hand held up beside the head.
Both hands, fingers wiggling, move down like falling rain.
signs.notes: The finger wiggle is not rendered.

signs.description: Both hands, fingers fluttering, drift gently down.
signs.notes: The flutter is not rendered.

Two W hands tap together.
Two L hands draw apart.
Two fists pedal in alternating circles.
Both cupped hands at the cheeks move outward, as puffed cheeks.
A V hand hops up off the palm of the other hand and lands again.
An index finger brushes up the nose, twice.
Both open hands at the temples, as antlers.

A C hand draws down the middle of the chest.
